title: Grid Consistency on Profile
summary: Simple visual consistency helps strangers understand you in three seconds.

sections.heading: Orientation — Lesson Start
sections.subtitle: Lesson Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
- What will you understand? Consistency helps strangers understand you quickly.
- Anyone new visiting your profile makes a very quick decision: Should they continue following or move on?
- Grid consistency reduces confusion — and clarifies the type of content before they read a single caption.

sections.heading: Tension — The Problem
sections.subtitle: The Problem
sections.contentMarkdown:
- A random grid = a confusing message.
- If each post has a different color and style — the visitor feels that the account lacks direction even if the content is strong.
- Visual clutter makes new followers not understand what exactly you can help them with.

sections.heading: Core Idea — Simple Consistency Delivers Meaning Faster
sections.subtitle: Simple Consistency Delivers Meaning Faster
sections.contentMarkdown:
- Consistency does not mean that every post is a copy of the other — it means the same spirit: Similar colors, a consistent font, and a clear cover style.
- When the grid is clear — anyone new quickly identifies your niche and value — this improves the quality of followers not just the quantity.
- Start with a few rules that you actually stick to — instead of a complicated system that doesn't last two weeks.

sections.heading: Comparison — Confusing or Clear First Impression?
sections.subtitle: Confusing or Clear First Impression?
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Inconsistent Grid | Consistent Grid |
|----------------|------------|
| Changing colors and fonts — the visitor leaves quickly because they don't understand the overall theme | Clear and repetitive style — the visitor understands the identity in seconds and is ready to follow confidently |

sections.heading: Glossary — Consistency Management Terms
sections.subtitle: Consistency Management Terms
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|---------|--------|------|
| Grid Pattern | The repeated visual arrangement in the format of posts | Educational · Story · Call to Action then repeat the same cycle |
| Cover Consistency | Stability of video cover shapes in font and overall color | Same font and same title placement in every cover |
| Visual Checklist | A pre-publishing checklist that ensures identity consistency | «Are the color, tone, and cover matching the pattern?» |

Change the identity every week to stay fresh.
